name: tiny_cube
description: Tiny noiseless 4ch x 16 chirps x 32 samples, 2 scatterers (TDM 2TX x 2RX); includes range-angle maps (rect and Hann angle window)

rangeAngle.description: Sum over all Doppler bins d of |AngleFFT(TDMcomp(X[:, r, d], v_d))|^2, v_d = (d - M/2)*dv; +j kernel, fftshift, Sigma(w)-normalised; shape (Nr, Na), row-major

hann.note: Python default angle window (periodic Hann over ULA slots)

tolerances.toleranceNotes: truth*Abs = interpolation bias (0.03 bin, 0.05 deg) + largest deterministic offset in this case (range-Doppler coupling, carrier scaling, cos(phi) projection of the 1-D azimuth FFT). angleDeg is compared with truth.angleDeg only when the velocity is not aliased.
